release_tools.decision: NX-034 D1/D2 (dispatcher 2026-10-11): manifests are signed with OpenSSH ssh-keygen -Y (namespace nexloop-release); SBOMs by syft and vulnerability counts by grype, at exactly these versions. A missing or different tool is reported, never a pass. Binary digests are recorded when the tools are first installed on the CI host from their official release archives (status below). Installed on the CI host on 2026-10-11 (owner decision O3): official release archives checked against the published checksums on the development machine and again on the CI host, binaries in the CI user's own directory (no root); the archive and binary digests above are what a re-install must reproduce. The grype vulnerability database is fetched by a daily update job only (imported after its checksum is checked; scans never download one).

grype.reason: grype 0.86.1 reads only schema v5 vulnerability databases, the last of which was built on 2026-03-09, so the D12 age limit could never be met and findings stopped at that date (docs/release/run-grype-v6-20261017.md). Archive checked against the release's published checksums on the development machine; the binary digest is that of the archive's grype. Installation on the CI host is a B-class step of that runbook.

deployment_tools.decision: NX-035 D1 (dispatcher 2026-10-14): the PG backup is pgBackRest (repo1 on APP_HOST, repo2 S3-compatible, client-side aes-256-cbc) and the file and restore-journal backup is restic (client-side encryption), at exactly these versions. Pinned here by version and official source only; nothing is downloaded by the repository or its tests. The package or archive sha256 is checked against the published checksum on the administration machine and again on the host at installation (NX-035-deploy-runbook.md steps 2.1 and 3.1, B class, owner-confirmed) and recorded here then; the PG image of DATA_HOST carries the same pgBackRest version (built by NX-034, digest in the release manifest). nexloop-backup refuses a pgBackRest whose `pgbackrest version` is not this one (--expected-version).
